title: Scanner runtime correlation pack
notes: Tracks Greenbone probe/sync/import degradation and drift between Proxmox fleet inventory and vulnerability runtime.

stream_rules.title: Greenbone Sync Or Import Degradation
stream_rules.operator_action: Inspect probe, target sync and import logs before retrying the scanner workflow from the vulnerability page.
stream_rules.sigma_yaml:
title: Greenbone Sync Or Import Degradation
id: sigma-greenbone-sync-or-import-degradation
status: experimental
logsource:
  product: siem
  service: vulnerability
detection:
  selection_action:
    event.action:
      - vuln.greenbone_probe_failed
      - vuln.sync_failed
      - vuln.import_failed
  condition: selection_action
level: high

stream_rules.title: Fleet Scan Coverage Stale
stream_rules.operator_action: Check whether the affected fleet nodes are reachable and whether their OpenVAS target mapping is still valid.
stream_rules.sigma_yaml:
title: Fleet Scan Coverage Stale
id: sigma-fleet-scan-coverage-stale
status: experimental
logsource:
  product: siem
  service: vulnerability
detection:
  selection_action:
    event.action:
      - vuln.coverage_stale
      - vuln.target_unmapped
  condition: selection_action
level: medium

stream_rules.title: Scanner Target Drift Against Proxmox Inventory
stream_rules.operator_action: Investigate whether new Proxmox guests were created or whether OpenVAS target reconciliation failed.
stream_rules.sigma_yaml:
title: Scanner Target Drift Against Proxmox Inventory
id: sigma-scanner-target-drift-against-proxmox-inventory
status: experimental
logsource:
  product: siem
  service: vulnerability
detection:
  selection_action:
    event.action:
      - vuln.target_drift_detected
      - vuln.fleet_inventory_changed
  condition: selection_action
level: medium
